## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New capability or feature
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling, workflow, dependencies, or maintenance
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates only
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal code structure change with no behavioral difference

## Quality Gates Checklist

Before requesting review or merging, verify all local quality gates pass:

- [ ] `make check` — byte-compilation succeeds without syntax errors
- [ ] `make lint` — Ruff code style and static lint checks pass
- [ ] `make typecheck` — Mypy static type analysis passes
- [ ] `make test` — Full unittest test suite passes
- [ ] `make build` — Production wheel and sdist packages build cleanly

## Factual & Safety Integrity

- [ ] All factual claims trace directly to verified project evidence
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or `.env` files are tracked
- [ ] Factual, human-approval, and budget boundaries remain intact
